issues.title: Swashbuckle.AspNetCore Package Version
issues.description: The Swashbuckle.AspNetCore package is using version 6.4.0, which is compatible with .NET 8 but not the latest version. Updated to version 6.5.0 for better .NET 8 support and bug fixes.
issues.impact: Improved compatibility with .NET 8 OpenAPI features and bug fixes
issues.remediation: Updated Swashbuckle.AspNetCore package version from 6.4.0 to 6.5.0 in MinimalAPIProject.csproj

recommendations: All packages are now up-to-date and compatible with .NET 8
Nullable reference types are properly enabled
ImplicitUsings feature is enabled for cleaner code
Run comprehensive tests to ensure functionality remains intact
